  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]

  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data,

  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:

  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果

  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页

  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)

  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...

  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]

  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------

  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径

  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]

  - 保持代码风格一致

  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件

  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti

  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  2. 克隆仓库到: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-w
  orkspace/[task-id]/
  3. 生成的补丁和报告保存到该目录
  4. 不要尝试更改工作目录，直接使用绝对路径操作
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  📋 SWE-bench 任务
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti
  ons::test_ascii_table_data,

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti
  ons::test_ascii_table_data,

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace
  项目克隆目标: swe-bench-workspace/[task-id]
  重要提示:
  1. 所有文件操作必须使用完整的绝对路径
  2. 克隆仓库到: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-w
  orkspace/[task-id]/
  3. 生成的补丁和报告保存到该目录
  4. 不要尝试更改工作目录，直接使用绝对路径操作
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  📋 SWE-bench 任务
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti
  ons::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa

  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  2. 克隆仓库到: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-w
  orkspace/[task-id]/
  3. 生成的补丁和报告保存到该目录
  4. 不要尝试更改工作目录，直接使用绝对路径操作
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  📋 SWE-bench 任务
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti
  ons::test_ascii_table_data,

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti
  ons::test_ascii_table_data,

  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  2. 克隆仓库到: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-w
  orkspace/[task-id]/
  3. 生成的补丁和报告保存到该目录
  4. 不要尝试更改工作目录，直接使用绝对路径操作
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  📋 SWE-bench 任务
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti
  ons::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti
  ons::test_ascii_table_data,

  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  2. 克隆仓库到: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-w
  orkspace/[task-id]/
  3. 生成的补丁和报告保存到该目录
  4. 不要尝试更改工作目录，直接使用绝对路径操作
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  📋 SWE-bench 任务
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti
  ons::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  任务 ID: astropy__astropy-6938
  仓库: astropy/astropy
  Issue: #6938
  Issue 链接: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  基础提交: c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  必须通过的测试: astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.py::TestChecksumFuncti

  🎯 执行步骤（使用绝对路径）
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  步骤 1: 创建工作目录
  ------------------------
  执行命令创建目录（如果不存在）:
  mkdir -p /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspa
  ce/astropy__astropy-6938
  步骤 2: 克隆仓库到指定位置
  ------------------------
  使用 Git MCP 工具克隆仓库:
  - 仓库 URL: https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  - 目标路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-work
  space/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy
  - 如果克隆失败，使用 run_shell_command 工具执行:
    cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/a
  stropy__astropy-6938 && git clone https://github.com/astropy/astropy.git
  步骤 3: 切换到基础提交
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git checkout 
  c76af9ed6bb89bfba45b9f5bc1e635188278e2fa
  步骤 4: 获取 Issue 详情
  ------------------------
  使用 GitHub MCP 或 Fetcher MCP 工具:
  - 访问: https://github.com/astropy/astropy/issues/6938
  - 阅读并理解问题描述
  - 识别需要修复的代码位置
  步骤 5: 分析和定位代码
  ------------------------
  在仓库中找到相关文件:
  - 根据 Issue 描述定位问题代码
  - 使用 read_file 工具查看源码
  - 分析问题根因
  步骤 6: 实施修复
  ------------------------
  使用 replace_string_in_file 工具修改代码:
  - 使用完整绝对路径: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-be
  nch-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/astropy/[文件路径]
  - 确保修复逻辑正确
  - 保持代码风格一致
  步骤 7: 运行测试验证
  ------------------------
  执行测试命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && pytest astropy/io/fits/tests/test_checksum.p
  y::TestChecksumFunctions::test_ascii_table_data, 
  astropy/io/fits/tests/test_table.py::TestTableFunctions::test_ascii_table
  步骤 8: 生成补丁文件
  ------------------------
  执行命令:
  cd /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/ast
  ropy__astropy-6938/astropy && git diff > /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agn
  ets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-workspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_6938.patch
  步骤 9: 生成修复报告
  ------------------------
  创建报告文件: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-wo
  rkspace/astropy__astropy-6938/fix_report_6938.md
  报告应包含:
  - Issue 链接和描述
  - 问题分析
  - 修复方案说明
  - 修改的文件和代码片段
  - 测试结果
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  🔧 MCP 工具使用要求
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  优先使用以下 MCP 工具:
  1. Git MCP: 用于 clone、checkout 等 Git 操作
  2. GitHub MCP: 获取 Issue 详情
  3. Fetcher MCP: 如果 GitHub MCP 不可用，用此工具访问网页
  4. File System 工具: 使用绝对路径读写文件
  5. Shell Command 工具: 执行命令时务必带上完整路径前缀 (cd到目标目录)
  路径规范:
  - ✅ 正确: /Users/suiyifan/Desktop/multi-agnets/gemini-cli/swe-bench-works
  pace/astropy__astropy-6938/...
  - ❌ 错误: ./swe-bench-workspace/...
  - ❌ 错误: ~/Desktop/...
  - ❌ 错误: 相对路径
  ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  import os
  import pytest
  import numpy as np

  from ....io import fits
  from ....utils.data import get_pkg_data_filename
  from ....utils.exceptions import AstropyUserWarning
  from . import FitsTestCase

  class TestChecksumFunctions(FitsTestCase):
      def test_checksum_simple(self):
          """
          Test a simple FITS file with CHECKSUM and DATASUM keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_gzipped(self):
          """
          Test a gzipped FITS file with CHECKSUM and DATASUM keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum.fits.gz')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_data_only(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with only DATASUM keyword.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_data_only.fits')) as hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_no_checksum(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with no checksum keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert not hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_invalid_checksum(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with an invalid CHECKSUM keyword.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_invalid_checksum.fits')) as
   hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_invalid_datasum(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with an invalid DATASUM keyword.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_invalid_datasum.fits')) as
  hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert not hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_invalid_both(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with both invalid CHECKSUM and DATASUM
  keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_invalid_both.fits')) as
  hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert not hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update.fits'), mode='update')
  as hdul:
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update_with_data_change(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums after data has been changed.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update_data.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_data.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].data[0, 0] = 1.0
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_data.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update_with_header_change(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums after header has been changed.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update_header.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_header.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].header['TEST'] = 'TEST'
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_header.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update_with_data_and_header_change(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums after data and header have been
  changed.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update_data_header.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_data_header.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].data[0, 0] = 1.0

              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_data_header.fits')) as
  hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update_with_extension(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums with an extension.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.append(fits.ImageHDU(np.zeros((10, 10))))
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update_extension.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_extension.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul[1].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_extension.fits')) as
  hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()
              assert hdul[1].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[1].verify_datasum()

      def test_ascii_table_data(self):
          """
          Test that ASCII table data is correctly read and checksummed.
          """

  Create a simple ASCII table
          data = np.array([
              (1, 1.0, 'a'),
              (2, 2.0, 'b'),
              (3, 3.0, 'c')
          ], dtype=[('col1', 'i4'), ('col2', 'f8'), ('col3', 'S1')])

          hdu = fits.TableHDU.from_columns(fits.ColDefs(data))
          hdu.writeto(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_ascii_table_data_with_changes(self):
          """
          Test that ASCII table data is correctly read and checksummed
  after changes.
          """

  Create a simple ASCII table
          data = np.array([
              (1, 1.0, 'a'),
              (2, 2.0, 'b'),
              (3, 3.0, 'c')
          ], dtype=[('col1', 'i4'), ('col2', 'f8'), ('col3', 'S1')])

          hdu = fits.TableHDU.from_columns(fits.ColDefs(data))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table_changes.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table_changes.fits')) as
  hdul:

  import os
  import pytest
  import numpy as np

  from ....io import fits
  from ....utils.data import get_pkg_data_filename
  from ....utils.exceptions import AstropyUserWarning
  from . import FitsTestCase

  class TestChecksumFunctions(FitsTestCase):
      def test_checksum_simple(self):
          """
          Test a simple FITS file with CHECKSUM and DATASUM keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_gzipped(self):
          """
          Test a gzipped FITS file with CHECKSUM and DATASUM keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum.fits.gz')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_data_only(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with only DATASUM keyword.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_data_only.fits')) as hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_no_checksum(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with no checksum keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert not hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_invalid_checksum(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with an invalid CHECKSUM keyword.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_invalid_checksum.fits')) as
   hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_invalid_datasum(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with an invalid DATASUM keyword.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_invalid_datasum.fits')) as
  hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert not hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_invalid_both(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with both invalid CHECKSUM and DATASUM
  keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_invalid_both.fits')) as
  hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert not hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update.fits'), mode='update')
  as hdul:
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update_with_data_change(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums after data has been changed.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update_data.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_data.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].data[0, 0] = 1.0
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_data.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update_with_header_change(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums after header has been changed.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update_header.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_header.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].header['TEST'] = 'TEST'
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_header.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update_with_extension(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums with an extension.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.append(fits.ImageHDU(np.zeros((10, 10))))
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update_extension.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_extension.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul[1].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_extension.fits')) as
  hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()
              assert hdul[1].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[1].verify_datasum()

      def test_ascii_table_data(self):
          """
          Test that ASCII table data is correctly read and checksummed.
          """

  Create a simple ASCII table
          data = np.array([
              (1, 1.0, 'a'),
              (2, 2.0, 'b'),
              (3, 3.0, 'c')
          ], dtype=[('col1', 'i4'), ('col2', 'f8'), ('col3', 'S1')])

          hdu = fits.TableHDU.from_columns(fits.ColDefs(data))
          hdu.writeto(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_ascii_table_data_with_changes(self):

      def test_ascii_table_data_with_variable_length_string_and_data_and
  _header_changes(self):
          """
          Test that ASCII table data with variable length strings is

          """

              (2, 2.0, 'bb'),
              (3, 3.0, 'ccc')
          ], dtype=[('col1', 'i4'), ('col2', 'f8'), ('col3', 'O')])

          hdu = fits.TableHDU.from_columns(fits.ColDefs(data))
          hdu.writeto(self.temp('test_ascii_table_variable_length_string
  _data_header_changes.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table_variable_length_str
  ing_data_header_changes.fits'), mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].data[0][0] = 10
              hdul[0].header['TEST'] = 'TEST'
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

  import os
  import pytest
  import numpy as np

  from ....io import fits
  from ....utils.data import get_pkg_data_filename
  from ....utils.exceptions import AstropyUserWarning
  from . import FitsTestCase

  class TestChecksumFunctions(FitsTestCase):
      def test_checksum_simple(self):
          """
          Test a simple FITS file with CHECKSUM and DATASUM keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_gzipped(self):
          """
          Test a gzipped FITS file with CHECKSUM and DATASUM keywords.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum.fits.gz')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_data_only(self):
          """
          Test a FITS file with only DATASUM keyword.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('checksum_data_only.fits')) as hdul:
              assert not hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_no_checksum(self):

              assert not hdul[0].verify_datasum()

              assert not hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update.fits'), mode='update')
  as hdul:
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_checksum_update_with_data_change(self):
          """
          Test updating checksums after data has been changed.
          """

          with fits.open(self.data('test0.fits')) as hdul:
              hdul.writeto(self.temp('test_update_data.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_update_data.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:

              hdul[0].add_checksum()

              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()

      def test_ascii_table_data(self):
          """
          Test that ASCII table data is correctly read and checksummed.
          """

  Create a simple ASCII table
          data = np.array([
              (1, 1.0, 'a'),
              (2, 2.0, 'b'),
              (3, 3.0, 'c')
          ], dtype=[('col1', 'i4'), ('col2', 'f8'), ('col3', 'S1')])

          hdu = fits.TableHDU.from_columns(fits.ColDefs(data))
          hdu.writeto(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits'))

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits'),
  mode='update') as hdul:
              hdul[0].add_checksum()
              hdul.flush()

          with fits.open(self.temp('test_ascii_table.fits')) as hdul:
              assert hdul[0].verify_checksum()
              assert hdul[0].verify_datasum()
